pr_title: Publish verified Oyatie API contract surface
summary: F5 review of PR #1 found a bootstrap that is too large to review deterministically and was merged with a failed static ADR-0039 wiring gate. GitHub metadata reports 1070 files and 214313 additions; gh pr diff was too large for GitHub's diff endpoint, so review used PR metadata plus local merge-commit diff/stat evidence. Highest severity: BLOCKER.

findings.file: GitHub PR #1 statusCheckRollup / workflow static ADR-0039 wiring gate
findings.issue: PR #1 was merged while the static ADR-0039 wiring gate reported FAILURE. A PR named as a verified API contract surface cannot be treated as a reliable quality baseline when the wiring/static verification lane failed at merge time.
findings.remediation: Re-run the ADR-0039/static wiring lane on the current protected branch SHA, fix every residual violation, and attach passing evidence before using PR #1 as a reference baseline for later quality or contract-drift decisions.

findings.file: PR #1 merge diff: 1070 files, 214313 additions; contracts/openapi/**, contracts/asyncapi/**, contracts/proto/**, crates/**, workflows/**
findings.issue: The PR shipped a 1070-file greenfield bootstrap in one review unit. That collapses contracts, generated-looking bindings, tests, workflow policy, crate implementations, and docs into one boundary, making facet-local testability and deterministic regression attribution weak.
findings.remediation: Backfill a machine-readable inventory that groups the PR #1 surface by domain, endpoint/schema, crate, owner, and verification command. Treat missing inventory rows as fixup tasks before allowing this bootstrap to anchor future changes.

findings.issue: The API contract bootstrap also introduced an unrelated local payroll prompt artifact. Mixing unrelated product prompt material into a contract-surface baseline increases audit noise and makes future quality reviews harder to scope.
findings.remediation: Move unrelated prompt/product artifacts into their own change history or mark them explicitly as out-of-scope historical imports so API contract verification can reason only over contract, crate, and workflow surfaces.

findings.file: GitHub PR #1 diff endpoint / local merge diff
findings.issue: The PR is large enough that the GitHub PR diff endpoint refuses it as too_large. That is direct evidence that normal reviewer and automation paths cannot inspect the change as a single deterministic unit.
findings.remediation: For any remaining baseline validation, split review into generated slices with stable manifests and per-slice hashes, then require future PRs to stay under a reviewable file-count threshold or attach generated diff indexes.
